files.description: This is a subtle ocean storm sound. This sound was created just with human breathing and in post reverb was added as well as different breathing sounds from a human were all added in separate tracks to create a more immersive experience. This sound was recorded with a Zoom H6 recorder.

files.description: An outdoor field recording of a rain storm with the ocean rumbling in the distance. This was recorded on a Zoom H4N Pro and cleaned up in Audacity.
